**Nexo v0.4 beta 6** brings picture in picture, join and leave sounds, moving people between voice channels,
and a way to wake up a muted friend. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server too (with Nexo Server: stop it, run `nexo-server update`, start it again).
> Moving people and Wake up need the new server; everything else works on any server.

## What's new

- **Picture in picture.** In a call, open a text channel while you're watching a stream: it keeps playing
  in a small player in the corner (or shows a friend's camera when you aren't watching a stream). Drag it
  to any corner, click it to go back to the call, or close it with **×**. **Pop out** opens it in its own
  always-on-top window that keeps playing while Nexo is minimized or you're in a game. Stream and camera
  tiles in the call have a **Pop out** button too.
- **Join and leave sounds.** A short sound when someone joins or leaves your voice channel, and when you
  join or leave. Turn them off with the other sound effects in **Settings → Audio & video**.
- **Move people.** The owner and admins can move someone to another voice channel: right-click them and
  pick a channel under **Move to**, or drag their name in the sidebar onto another voice channel.
- **Wake up.** Right-click a friend who is muted or deafened and choose **Wake up** (or click the bell
  next to their name in the sidebar). They hear a chime, even while deafened, and their taskbar button
  flashes. Once every 15 seconds per friend.

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
